{{Quote|The Black Rakata shall never fall to you!|The One faces Revan|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''skirmish on Lehon''' was a battle that doubled as a rescue operation on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] at the [[Black Rakata]] [[Black Rakatan Settlement|settlement]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was told to liberate an [[Elders (Ramadan)|Elder Rakatan]] from [[the One]] at their settlement and was warned that a diplomatic solution would be impossible. Revan and two companions did battle with the Black Rakata and slew the One in order to free the prisoner who returned to the [[Elder Rakatan Settlement|elder settlement]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Prelude==
The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] [[Mission to Rakata Prime|visited]] [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malak]] in [[3960 BBY]] in order to find the [[Star Forge]] for [[Jedi Civil War|their eventual war]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The two Sith ripped the [[Rakata (language)|Rakata language]] from [[the One]] and implanted [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] in his mind in order to communicate with the [[Black Rakata]]. The Sith requested their aid in entering the [[Temple of the Ancients]] but the One said that the [[Elders (Ramadan)|Elder]] had an ancient tome that could help them enter the Temple; it was his wish that the Sith could recover the tome and defeat the Elders since he knew that the Sith could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to take it from them. But Revan and Malak instead met with and received assistance from the Elders with the One unaware of what had happened.<ref name="KOTOR" />

But Revan would return in [[3956 BBY]] as a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in order to seek out the Star Forge so that he could defeat his former apprentice Malak. He approached the One who once more requested Revan's help in exchange for getting him into the ancient Temple. But Revan once more decided to side with the Elders who convinced Revan to rescue one of their soldiers that the One was holding as a prisoner; he was forewarned that there could be no diplomatic solution due to the One's barbarism.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|We have seen you, interloper! You are a servant of the Elders. By order of the One you must die!|A Black Rakatan confronts Revan and his companions|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" />}}
Revan and two companions left the Elder settlement in order to free the prisoner from the One and to that end headed to their compound in the opposite direction. But as the trio neared the settlement the Black Rakatans and their [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] beasts arrived to kill them for their transgressions against the One. The three were able to defeat their attackers before heading into the settlement to find the prisoner.<ref name="KOTOR" />

But the team were attacked upon their entrance and killed the Black Rakatans such as [[Luo]] and [[Gjarshi]] who were positioned near the entrance. The One pulled a lever that released several rancors that he wished to unleash upon the invaders; these rancor beasts and the Black Rakatans were dispatched and the One himself was killed in the ensuing commotion.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Aftermath==
The One's defeat left no Black Rakatan survivors since their members and their beasts were all slain in the skirmish. Revan was able to return the prisoner back to the Elders who decided to aid Revan to enter the Temple. The Jedi entered the Temple with [[Jolee Bindo]] and [[Juhani]] in tow and were able to go on later [[Battle of Rakata Prime|to defeat]] Malak and see to the Star Forge's destruction.<ref name="KOTOR" />
